head_commit.message:
fix(stats): preserve accepted scan identity when resuming readers

A restarted import reader replaced the queued or running scan ID while recovering an unfinished full scan. Keep that request identity and state so callers can still observe its completion; completed or failed prior tasks receive a new recovery identity.

Cover queued/running full and incremental requests, terminal tasks, repeated reader starts, API coalescing and unchanged checkpoints. Include requested IDs in credit-rescan failures without extending the deadline.

Validation: 574 Core tests, strict all-targets Clippy, formatting, locked release and 23 isolated contract/check commands passed; the final strengthened regression was rerun. Original Ubuntu first-failure evidence remains and is not conclusively attributed to this independently reproduced bug.

Co-authored-by: Codex <codex@openai.com>
